basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Founding Engineer & Full-Stack AI Builder | 3× Founder | Production LLM Systems | Fintech
basics.summary: Founding-engineer instinct with 13+ years shipping full-stack + AI in production. Founding Engineer at Dronistics (empty repo to 500+ real-world deliveries), 3 AI products founded on the side (SwissNRI cross-border fintech, PulseView explainable market intelligence, Proplab). Lead AI Engineer at LumApps building production multi-agent workflows on Python and TypeScript with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Vertex AI: 2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly. Own the full stack: TS/React, Python, LLM pipelines, K8s, AWS/GCP, observability, on-call. Commercial instinct sharpened by MBA, revenue accountability at Beekeeper ($1.5M+ shipped), and running my own products with real users.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Shipped production multi-agent workflows on Python and TypeScript using LangGraph, Google ADK, OpenAI, Anthropic and Vertex AI. Tools over MCP, state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast quarterly.

Built AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one time-aware memory. Data modeling and API design that grounds RAG so agents stop hallucinating.
Own the reliability layer: evals, LangSmith tracing, cost-per-request instrumentation, fallback/retry for LLM and tool failures, and on-call for global production. Reliable AI features, not demos.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated; product team ships in new languages without a gatekeeper.
Architected Employee Referral System end to end (TypeScript/Vue, Java, PostgreSQL). Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Enterprise customers on the other end.
Designed a distributed templating engine (Kafka, Elastic Search, microfrontends) that cut customer setup time 90% and powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users).
Ran observability and global on-call (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io). Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort; engineers now lead features independently.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery startup. Shipped full stack (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs, AWS/Docker/Terraform infra) from empty repo to 500+ real-world deliveries.
Talked to Unilever and other partners directly, turned prototypes into signed opportunities, and delivered a CES Las Vegas showcase. 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.
